title: surrogate_key_oversize
description: Event: the Surrogate-Key a #[Cacheable] put or a donut write or refresh left on the response exceeds Fastly's limits, 1,024 bytes per key or 16,384 bytes for the header value. Only recorded: the keys are stored and sent as they are. Only the response header is measured, not the URI tag a #[Cacheable] adds to its own entry at save time nor the keys purged at the CDN. `headerBytes` is the header value's length, `longestKeyBytes` the longest key's. A state-served hit replays the stored header and emits no new event.
